CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 10

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 17
   C. 25
   D. 27

3. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

4. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 156
   D. 48

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

8. Solve for x: x + 6 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 18
   C. 12
   D. 6

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 15

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 48
   D. 2

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
3. 5² = 25
Final Answer: 25
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. C — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²
3. c² = 49 + 576
4. c² = 625
5. c = 25
Final Answer: 25 cm
